title: Operation Paperclip scientists and contact events at Redstone Arsenal and Los Alamos
summary: Matthew Brown tells of Operation Paperclip scientists and contact events at Redstone Arsenal and Los Alamos, about post-WWII at Huntsville, Alabama; Los Alamos, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: a lot of the Nazi scientists brought over you know they ended up all across the state but there's largely two groupings. The the Nazis and name only were kind of settled around Redstone Arsenal and then the the true believers
